# Set up.

Functions and parameters

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
setup_dir <- normalizePath("../setup", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(setup_dir, "setup.R"), local = TRUE)
sample <- "vhio136"
int_dir <- file.path(datapath, sample, "integrated")

plot_dir <- file.path(int_dir, "plots", "manuscript")
if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
  dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}
annot_dir <- file.path(int_dir, "traj")
if (!dir.exists(annot_dir)) {
  dir.create(annot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

Tumor-reactive TCR colors

```{r}
out_dir <- file.path(datapath_load, "outs")
shape_pool <- c(0, 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 3, 4, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25)
colors_tcr_tbl <- read.table(
  file.path(out_dir, "color_TCR.IDs.txt"),
  header = FALSE,
  skip = 1,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  col.names = c("rn", "TCR.ID", "Colors", "emergence")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TCR.ID = as.character(TCR.ID),
    emergence = factor(emergence, levels = c("d0", "d14", "d42"))
  )
tcr_ids <- unique(colors_tcr_tbl$TCR.ID)
if (length(tcr_ids) > length(shape_pool)) {
  stop(
    "There are more TCR.IDs than available discrete shapes. TCR.IDs: ",
    length(tcr_ids),
    "; shapes: ",
    length(shape_pool)
  )
}
shape_map <- setNames(shape_pool[seq_along(tcr_ids)], tcr_ids)
tcr_lib <- read.table(
  file.path(datapath_load, "outs", "tcr_lib.txt"),
  col.names = c("TCRb", "TCR.ID"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TCR.ID = as.character(TCR.ID),
    TCR.ID = ifelse(
      grepl("[0-9]+$", TCR.ID),
      sprintf("ID.%03d", as.integer(sub("^.*?([0-9]+)$", "\\1", TCR.ID))),
      TCR.ID
    )
  )
true_hits <- colors_tcr_tbl %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TCR.shape = unname(shape_map[TCR.ID])
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tcr_lib, by = "TCR.ID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cdr3 = sub("_.*", "", TCRb)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-rn)
tcr_color_map <- true_hits %>%
  dplyr::distinct(TCR.ID, Colors) %>%
  tibble::deframe()
tcr_shape_map <- true_hits %>%
  dplyr::distinct(TCR.ID, TCR.shape) %>%
  tibble::deframe()
tcr_emergence_map <- true_hits %>%
  dplyr::distinct(TCR.ID, emergence) %>%
  tibble::deframe()
```

# Non-naïve CD8T

## Load data.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
sample <- "vhio136"
compartment <- "cd8_int_nn"
obj <- readRDS(file.path(int_dir, "seurat", paste0(compartment, ".rds")))
obj@meta.data$time <- factor(obj@meta.data$time, levels = c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6"))
plots_list <- list()

# Keep the latest STACAS reduction
stacas_cols <- grep("^STACAS_snn_res\\.", colnames(obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
if (!length(stacas_cols)) stop("No STACAS_snn_res.* columns found.")
stacas_col <- tail(stacas_cols, 1)
obj@meta.data[head(stacas_cols, -1)] <- NULL
stacas_col
```

cd8_int_nn: 473 unique TCRs

```{r}
message("Number of TCRs tested in ", compartment, ": ", length(unique(unlist(strsplit(as.character(na.omit(obj$matched_ID)), ";")))))
table(obj$reactivity)
```

## Adjust

Merge the reactivity annotation with viral-recognition information. First, assess whether there is any overlap between epitope_species and reactive IDs. No overlap is detected, except for ID.198, which is annotated as non-reactive and matches EBV. Therefore, I annotate these cells as EBV.

```{r}
table(
  reactivity = !is.na(obj$reactivity),
  viral_epitope = !is.na(obj$epitope_species)
)
overlap_idx <- which(!is.na(obj$reactivity) & !is.na(obj$epitope_species))
overlap_cells <- rownames(obj@meta.data)[overlap_idx]
obj@meta.data[overlap_cells, c("reactivity", "epitope_species", "matched_ID", "tumor", "time", "sample", "clonotype_id", "cdr3", "v_gene", "j_gene"), drop = FALSE]

```

Number of cells with annotated specificity.

```{r}
idx <- !is.na(obj$epitope_species)
obj$reactivity[idx] <- as.character(obj$epitope_species[idx])
table(obj$reactivity, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Signatures

Heatmap IDs x timepoint.

```{r}
obj.sub <- obj
obj.sub$reactive_id <- ifelse(obj.sub$reactivity == "Yes", obj.sub$matched_ID, NA)
chosen_ids <- sort(unique(na.omit(obj.sub$reactive_id)))
ucell_cols <- c(
  "Oliverira_tumor_spec_TTE_UCell",
  "Oliverira_tumor_spec_TAct_UCell",
  "Oliverira_tumor_spec_TPE_UCell",
  "Oliverira_tumor_spec_TProl_UCell",
  "Oliverira_tumor_spec_TEM_UCell",
  "Lowery_prior_ICB_UCell",
  "Lowery_post_ICB_UCell",
  "Yossef_NeoTCR_PBL_UCell",
  "Hanada_UCell"
)
time_levels <- c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
df_tr <- obj.sub@meta.data %>%
  filter(reactive_id %in% chosen_ids) %>%
  select(reactive_id, time, all_of(ucell_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(ucell_cols), names_to = "signature", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(reactive_id, time, signature) %>%
  summarize(mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.na(reactive_id)) %>%
  mutate(time = factor(time, levels = time_levels),
         group = "TR")
ids_keep <- df_tr %>%
  distinct(reactive_id, time) %>%
  group_by(reactive_id) %>%
  tally(name = "n_times") %>%
  filter(n_times >= 1) %>%
  pull(reactive_id)
df_tr <- df_tr %>% filter(reactive_id %in% ids_keep)

# --- Plot ---
p <- lapply(ucell_cols, function(sig){
  mat <- df_tr %>%
    filter(signature == sig) %>%
    select(time, reactive_id, mean_score) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = reactive_id, values_from = mean_score) %>%
    column_to_rownames("time") %>%
    as.matrix()
  mat <- mat[time_levels, , drop = FALSE]
  ph <- pheatmap(
    mat,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    cellheight = 15,
    cellwidth = 15,
    color = viridis(50, option = "C"),
    main = sig,
    fontsize_row = 10,
    fontsize_col = 6,
    na_col = "white",
    silent = TRUE
  )
  ggplotify::as.ggplot(ph$gtable)
})
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("signatures_", compartment, ".pdf")), width = 15, height = 15, plot = wrap_plots(p, ncol = 2))
```

# Pheno x traj

First, calculate key frequencies over time-points.

```{r}
# --- Calculate longitudinal frequencies ---
clono_freq <- obj@meta.data %>%
  filter(
    time %in% c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6"),
    stringr::str_detect(chains, "TRB"), # Only TRB-containing clonotypes were considered to allow matching with the deep-sequencing data.
    !is.na(key)
  ) %>%
  select(key, TCRb, time) %>%
  count(time, key, TCRb, name = "n_cells") %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  mutate(
    total_cells_time = sum(n_cells),
    frequency = n_cells / total_cells_time
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    nesting(key, TCRb),
    time = c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
  ) %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  mutate(
    total_cells_time = dplyr::first(
      total_cells_time[!is.na(total_cells_time)],
      default = 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    time_numeric = dplyr::recode(
      time,
      "pre" = 0,
      "post1" = 14,
      "post2" = 42,
      "post6" = 140
    ),
    n_cells = tidyr::replace_na(n_cells, 0L),
    frequency = tidyr::replace_na(frequency, 0.0001),
    time = factor(
      time,
      levels = c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(key, TCRb, time_numeric) %>%
  select(
    key,
    TCRb,
    time,
    time_numeric,
    n_cells,
    total_cells_time,
    frequency
  )

```

```{r}
# --- Select annotation time ---
time <- "post6"

# --- Annotate clonotypes ---
annotation <- obj@meta.data %>%
  filter(
    .data$time == .env$time,
    stringr::str_detect(chains, "TRB")
  ) %>%
  count(key, TCRb, manual.annotation, name = "n_cells") %>%
  filter(!is.na(manual.annotation)) %>%
  group_by(key) %>%
  mutate(
    max_n_cells = max(n_cells),
    n_majority_annotations = sum(n_cells == max_n_cells)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_cells == max_n_cells,
    n_majority_annotations == 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(annotation_status = "Majority annotation") %>%
  select(
    key,
    TCRb,
    manual.annotation,
    n_cells,
    annotation_status
  ) %>%
  arrange(key, TCRb)

# --- Save annotation table ---
write.table(
  annotation,
  file = file.path(
    annot_dir,
    paste0("Single-cell_", compartment, "_", time, ".tsv")
  ),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

# --- Add phenotype to longitudinal frequencies ---
clono_pheno <- clono_freq %>%
  inner_join(
    annotation %>%
      distinct(key, TCRb, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = c("key", "TCRb")
  ) %>%
  arrange(key, TCRb, time_numeric)

assign(
  paste0("clono_pheno_", time),
  clono_pheno
)

# --- Plot longitudinal trajectories ---
p_clono_pheno <- ggplot(
  clono_pheno,
  aes(
    x = time_numeric,
    y = frequency,
    group = interaction(key, TCRb),
    color = manual.annotation
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ manual.annotation,
    ncol = 7
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 14, 42, 140),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = 10^(-4:1),
    labels = c(
      "0.0001",
      "0.001",
      "0.01",
      "0.1",
      "1",
      "10"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = manual_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Clonotype frequency"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.line = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.25,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.15,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(
      1.5,
      "pt"
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      color = "black"
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.3,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey85"
    ),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 9,
      color = "black"
    ),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.spacing.x = unit(
      0.8,
      "lines"
    ),
    aspect.ratio = 0.5,
    plot.margin = margin(
      5,
      5,
      5,
      5
    )
  )

print(p_clono_pheno)

# --- Save plot ---
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    annot_dir,
    paste0("Single-cell_", compartment, "_", time, ".png")
  ),
  plot = p_clono_pheno,
  width = 16,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```

### Fig. 3c
Alluvial plots of reactive PBLs (cellCount)

```{r}
time_levels <- c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
alluvial_col <- "manual.annotation"
alluvial_palette <- manual_colors
alluvial_na_label <- "NA"
alluvial_na_col <- "gray85"
if (!alluvial_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) {
  stop("Column not found in obj@meta.data: ", alluvial_col)
}
reactivity_levels <- c("Yes", "No", "Auto-reactive", "CMV", "EBV")
reactivity_present <- unique(as.character(obj$reactivity))
reactivity_present <- reactivity_present[!is.na(reactivity_present) & !reactivity_present %in% c("", "NA", "<NA>")]
reactivity_levels <- c(intersect(reactivity_levels, reactivity_present), setdiff(sort(reactivity_present), reactivity_levels))
state_global <- as.character(obj@meta.data[[alluvial_col]])
state_global <- ifelse(is.na(state_global) | state_global %in% c("", "NA", "<NA>"), alluvial_na_label, state_global)
state_levels <- sort(unique(state_global))
state_levels <- state_levels[!is.na(state_levels)]
if (is.null(names(alluvial_palette))) {
  state_cols <- setNames(alluvial_palette[seq_along(state_levels)], state_levels)
} else {
  state_cols <- alluvial_palette[state_levels]
}
if (alluvial_na_label %in% state_levels && alluvial_na_label %in% names(state_cols) && is.na(state_cols[alluvial_na_label])) {
  state_cols[alluvial_na_label] <- alluvial_na_col
}
if (alluvial_na_label %in% state_levels && !alluvial_na_label %in% names(state_cols)) {
  state_cols <- c(state_cols, setNames(alluvial_na_col, alluvial_na_label))
}
if (any(is.na(state_cols))) {
  stop("Some levels are missing in alluvial_palette: ", paste(state_levels[is.na(state_cols)], collapse = ", "))
}
df <- obj@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(as.character(reactivity) %in% reactivity_levels) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    reactivity = factor(as.character(reactivity), levels = reactivity_levels),
    time = factor(as.character(time), levels = time_levels),
    state = as.character(.data[[alluvial_col]]),
    state = ifelse(is.na(state) | state %in% c("", "NA", "<NA>"), alluvial_na_label, state),
    state = factor(state, levels = state_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(reactivity, time, state)
df_summary <- df %>%
  dplyr::count(reactivity, time, state, name = "n") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    reactivity = factor(reactivity_levels, levels = reactivity_levels),
    time = factor(time_levels, levels = time_levels),
    state = factor(state_levels, levels = state_levels),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    reactivity = factor(as.character(reactivity), levels = reactivity_levels),
    time = factor(as.character(time), levels = time_levels),
    state = factor(as.character(state), levels = state_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 0)
# --- Plot ---
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  df_summary,
  ggplot2::aes(x = time, stratum = state, alluvium = state, y = n, fill = state)
) +
  ggalluvial::geom_flow(stat = "alluvium", lode.guidance = "frontback", alpha = 0.75) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    ggplot2::aes(label = ggplot2::after_stat(count)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~reactivity, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = state_cols,
    limits = names(state_cols),
    breaks = names(state_cols),
    drop = FALSE,
    name = alluvial_col
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = time_levels) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Cell count"
  ) +
  ggplot2::guides(
    fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      title = alluvial_col,
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    aspect.ratio = 0.5,
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.4, "cm"),
    axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "plain")
  )
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Figure3c_", compartment, "_alluvial_reactivity.pdf")), height = 7.5, width = 7.5, plot = p)
print(p)
```

### Fig. 3d
Location in the UMAP of the TCR library-tested PBL-TILs and their reactivity.

```{r}
time_levels <- c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
emergence_levels <- c("d0", "d14", "d42")
background_col <- "gray85"
bad_values <- c("", "NA", "<NA>")
if (!exists("true_hits") || !all(c("TCR.ID", "TCR.shape", "emergence", "Colors") %in% colnames(true_hits))) {
  stop("true_hits must exist and contain columns: TCR.ID, TCR.shape, emergence and Colors")
}
true_hits_maps <- true_hits %>%
  dplyr::distinct(TCR.ID, TCR.shape, emergence, Colors) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TCR.ID = as.character(TCR.ID),
    TCR.shape = as.integer(TCR.shape),
    emergence = factor(as.character(emergence), levels = emergence_levels),
    Colors = as.character(Colors)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(TCR.ID), !TCR.ID %in% bad_values,
    !is.na(TCR.shape),
    !is.na(emergence),
    !is.na(Colors), !Colors %in% bad_values
  )
true_ids <- unique(true_hits_maps$TCR.ID)
id_candidates <- intersect(c("id", "matched_ID"), colnames(obj@meta.data))
if (length(id_candidates) == 0) {
  stop("Neither 'id' nor 'matched_ID' found in obj@meta.data.")
}
count_true_id_overlap <- function(x) {
  ids <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), ";")))
  sum(ids %in% true_ids, na.rm = TRUE)
}
id_col <- id_candidates[which.max(vapply(id_candidates, function(x) count_true_id_overlap(obj@meta.data[[x]]), numeric(1)))]
shape_mapping <- true_hits_maps %>%
  dplyr::distinct(TCR.ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(TCR.ID, TCR.shape) %>%
  tibble::deframe()
tcr_color_mapping <- true_hits_maps %>%
  dplyr::distinct(TCR.ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(TCR.ID, Colors) %>%
  tibble::deframe()
emb <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(obj, reduction = "umap"))
umap_cols <- colnames(emb)[1:2]
meta_cols <- unique(c("time", id_col))
plot_base <- cbind(
  emb[Seurat::Cells(obj), umap_cols, drop = FALSE],
  obj@meta.data[Seurat::Cells(obj), meta_cols, drop = FALSE]
)
plot_base$cell_id <- rownames(plot_base)
plot_context <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(emergence_levels, function(emergence_i) {
  tmp <- plot_base
  tmp$panel_title <- emergence_i
  tmp
}))
plot_highlight <- plot_base %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TCR.ID = as.character(.data[[id_col]])) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(TCR.ID, sep = ";") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TCR.ID = trimws(TCR.ID)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(TCR.ID %in% true_ids) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(true_hits_maps, by = "TCR.ID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    panel_title = as.character(emergence),
    shape_clone = TCR.ID
  )
missing_in_obj <- setdiff(true_ids, unique(plot_highlight$TCR.ID))
if (length(missing_in_obj) > 0) {
  message("TCR.IDs in true_hits not found in obj@", id_col, ": ", paste(missing_in_obj, collapse = ", "))
}
legend_breaks <- intersect(true_ids, unique(as.character(plot_highlight$TCR.ID)))
legend_breaks <- legend_breaks[
  legend_breaks %in% names(shape_mapping) &
    legend_breaks %in% names(tcr_color_mapping)
]
plot_context$time <- factor(plot_context$time, levels = time_levels)
plot_context$panel_title <- factor(plot_context$panel_title, levels = emergence_levels)
plot_highlight$time <- factor(plot_highlight$time, levels = time_levels)
plot_highlight$panel_title <- factor(plot_highlight$panel_title, levels = emergence_levels)
plot_highlight$shape_clone <- factor(plot_highlight$shape_clone, levels = legend_breaks)

# --- Plot ---
p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = plot_context,
    ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[umap_cols[1]]], y = .data[[umap_cols[2]]]),
    color = background_col,
    size = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.85,
    shape = 16
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = plot_highlight,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data[[umap_cols[1]]],
      y = .data[[umap_cols[2]]],
      color = TCR.ID,
      shape = shape_clone
    ),
    size = 4,
    stroke = 0.75,
    alpha = 1,
    fill = NA
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(panel_title ~ time) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    name = "TCR.ID",
    values = tcr_color_mapping[legend_breaks],
    breaks = legend_breaks,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(
    name = "TCR.ID",
    values = shape_mapping[legend_breaks],
    breaks = legend_breaks,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::guides(
    color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      title = "TCR.ID",
      override.aes = list(
        shape = unname(shape_mapping[legend_breaks]),
        colour = unname(tcr_color_mapping[legend_breaks]),
        size = 2.8,
        stroke = 0.6,
        alpha = 1,
        fill = NA
      ),
      order = 1
    ),
    shape = "none"
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() +
  ggplot2::theme_classic() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "plain"),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25)
  )
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Figure3d_", compartment, "_umap_reactive_IDs.pdf")), width = 10, height = 10, plot = p)
```

### Fig. 3e
Alluvial plots of selected reactive PBLs.

```{r}
highlighted_clones <- unique(true_hits$TCR.ID)
highlighted_clones[highlighted_clones == "ID.094"] <- "ID.094;ID.095"
highlighted_clones_match <- unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(highlighted_clones, ";"))))
time_levels <- c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
alluvial_col <- "manual.annotation"
alluvial_palette <- manual_colors
alluvial_na_label <- "NA"
alluvial_na_col <- "gray85"
id_col <- if ("id" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) "id" else "matched_ID"
if (!alluvial_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) {
  stop("Column not found in obj@meta.data: ", alluvial_col)
}
id_chr <- as.character(obj@meta.data[[id_col]])
id_chr[is.na(id_chr)] <- ""
id_match <- vapply(strsplit(id_chr, ";"), function(x) {
  ids <- trimws(x)
  ids <- ids[ids %in% highlighted_clones_match]
  if (length(ids) == 0) {
    NA_character_
  } else if (any(ids %in% c("ID.094", "ID.095"))) {
    "ID.094;ID.095"
  } else {
    ids[1]
  }
}, character(1))
df <- obj@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(id = id_match) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(id)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    id = factor(id, levels = highlighted_clones),
    time = factor(as.character(time), levels = time_levels),
    state = as.character(.data[[alluvial_col]]),
    state = ifelse(is.na(state) | state %in% c("", "NA", "<NA>"), alluvial_na_label, state)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, time, state)
state_levels <- sort(unique(as.character(df$state)))
state_levels <- state_levels[!is.na(state_levels)]
if (is.null(names(alluvial_palette))) {
  state_cols <- setNames(alluvial_palette[seq_along(state_levels)], state_levels)
} else {
  state_cols <- alluvial_palette[state_levels]
}
if (alluvial_na_label %in% state_levels && alluvial_na_label %in% names(state_cols) && is.na(state_cols[alluvial_na_label])) {
  state_cols[alluvial_na_label] <- alluvial_na_col
}
if (alluvial_na_label %in% state_levels && !alluvial_na_label %in% names(state_cols)) {
  state_cols <- c(state_cols, setNames(alluvial_na_col, alluvial_na_label))
}
if (any(is.na(state_cols))) {
  stop("Some levels are missing in alluvial_palette: ", paste(state_levels[is.na(state_cols)], collapse = ", "))
}
df_summary <- df %>%
  dplyr::count(id, time, state, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    time = factor(time_levels, levels = time_levels),
    state = factor(state_levels, levels = state_levels),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    id = factor(id, levels = highlighted_clones),
    time = factor(as.character(time), levels = time_levels),
    state = factor(as.character(state), levels = state_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 0)
if (nrow(df_summary) == 0) {
  stop("No cells found for highlighted_clones.")
}
max_y <- df_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id, time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::pull(total) %>%
  max(na.rm = TRUE)

# --- Plot ---
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  df_summary,
  ggplot2::aes(x = time, stratum = state, alluvium = state, y = n, fill = state)
) +
  ggalluvial::geom_flow(stat = "alluvium", lode.guidance = "frontback", alpha = 0.75) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    ggplot2::aes(label = ggplot2::after_stat(count)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~id, ncol = 4) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max_y),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = state_cols,
    limits = names(state_cols),
    breaks = names(state_cols),
    drop = FALSE,
    name = alluvial_col
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = time_levels) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Time", y = "Cell count") +
  ggplot2::guides(
    fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      title = alluvial_col,
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    aspect.ratio = 0.5,
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.4, "cm"),
    axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "plain")
  )
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Figure3e_", compartment, "_alluvial_reactive_IDs.pdf")), width = 10, height = 10, plot = p)
print(p)
```

### Fig. 3f
Longitudinal CDR-3β repertoires of tumor-reactive PBLs

```{r}
path <- file.path(datapath_load, "outs", "pbl_raw_RIO136.tsv")
data_raw <- read.table(path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TRBV = stringr::str_extract(nucleotide, "TCRBV[0-9]+-0?[0-9]"),
    TRBV = gsub("-0", "-", TRBV),
    TRBV = gsub("TCRBV0", "TCRBV", TRBV),
    TRBV = gsub("TCRBV", "TRBV", TRBV),
    TRBJ = stringr::str_extract(nucleotide, "TCRBJ[0-9]+-0?[0-9]"),
    TRBJ = gsub("-0", "-", TRBJ),
    TRBJ = gsub("TCRBJ0", "TCRBJ", TRBJ),
    TRBJ = gsub("TCRBJ", "TRBJ", TRBJ)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TCRb = paste0(aminoAcid, "_", TRBV, "_", TRBJ),
    cdr3 = sub("_.*", "", TCRb)
  )
data_raw <- data_raw %>%
  dplyr::select(-TCRb) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(true_hits, by = "cdr3") %>%
  dplyr::select(cdr3, time, freq_in)
emergence_levels <- c("d0", "d14", "d42")
bad_values <- c("", "NA", "<NA>")
if (!exists("true_hits") || !all(c("cdr3", "TCR.ID", "Colors", "emergence") %in% colnames(true_hits))) {
  stop("true_hits must exist and contain columns: cdr3, TCR.ID, Colors and emergence")
}
true_hits_traj <- true_hits %>%
  dplyr::distinct(cdr3, TCR.ID, Colors, emergence) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cdr3 = as.character(cdr3),
    TCR.ID = as.character(TCR.ID),
    Colors = as.character(Colors),
    emergence = factor(as.character(emergence), levels = emergence_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(cdr3), !cdr3 %in% bad_values,
    !is.na(TCR.ID), !TCR.ID %in% bad_values,
    !is.na(Colors), !Colors %in% bad_values,
    !is.na(emergence)
  )
true_cdr3 <- unique(true_hits_traj$cdr3)
true_ids <- unique(true_hits_traj$TCR.ID)
color_map <- true_hits_traj %>%
  dplyr::distinct(TCR.ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(TCR.ID, Colors) %>%
  tibble::deframe()
timepoints <- data_raw %>%
  dplyr::distinct(time) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(day = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(time)))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(day) %>%
  dplyr::pull(time)
tp_days <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(timepoints)))
floor_y <- 0.001 
data_traj <- data_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cdr3 = as.character(cdr3),
    time = as.character(time)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cdr3 %in% true_cdr3) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cdr3, time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(freq_in = sum(freq_in, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    cdr3 = true_cdr3,
    time = timepoints,
    fill = list(freq_in = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(true_hits_traj, by = "cdr3") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    day = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(time))),
    freq_plot = pmax(freq_in, floor_y),
    TCR.ID = factor(TCR.ID, levels = true_ids),
    emergence = factor(as.character(emergence), levels = emergence_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TCR.ID), !is.na(emergence), !is.na(day))
matched_summary <- data_traj %>%
  dplyr::group_by(TCR.ID, emergence) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    max_freq = max(freq_in, na.rm = TRUE),
    detected = any(freq_in > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
missing_ids <- matched_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(!detected) %>%
  dplyr::pull(TCR.ID) %>%
  as.character()
if (length(missing_ids) > 0) {
  message("TCR.IDs from true_hits plotted at floor_y only because they were not detected in data_raw: ", paste(missing_ids, collapse = ", "))
}
legend_breaks <- intersect(true_ids, unique(as.character(data_traj$TCR.ID)))

# --- Function ---
tcr_y_scale_log <- function(floor_y = 1e-3) {
  ggplot2::scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(floor_y, 10),
    breaks = c(1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1, 10),
    labels = c("0.001", "0.01", "0.1", "1", "10")
  )
}
tcr_theme_trajectory <- function(base_size = 8, aspect.ratio = 0.5) {
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9.5, face = "plain", colour = "black", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8, face = "plain", colour = "black"),
      aspect.ratio = aspect.ratio
    )
}

# --- Plot ---
p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = tp_days,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    colour = "grey85"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = data_traj,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = day,
      y = freq_plot,
      group = interaction(TCR.ID, cdr3),
      colour = TCR.ID
    ),
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~emergence, ncol = 3) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
    values = color_map[legend_breaks],
    breaks = legend_breaks,
    name = "TCR.ID",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  tcr_y_scale_log(floor_y = floor_y) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = tp_days) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(atop("Frequency of unique", paste("CDR3", beta, " amino acid seq (%)"))),
    title = "Longitudinal CDR3 beta trajectories of true hits by emergence"
  ) +
  tcr_theme_trajectory()
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Figure3f_", compartment, "_trajectory_reactive_IDs.pdf")), width = 17.5, height = 7.5, plot = p)
print(p)
```

### Fig. S8d
General overview of reactive PBL distribution.

```{r}
match_col <- if ("matched_ID" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) "matched_ID" else "id"
reactivity_chr <- as.character(obj$reactivity)
matched_chr <- as.character(obj@meta.data[[match_col]])
has_reactivity <- !is.na(reactivity_chr) & !reactivity_chr %in% c("", "NA", "<NA>")
has_match <- !is.na(matched_chr) & !matched_chr %in% c("", "NA", "<NA>")
obj$reactivity_plot <- ifelse(
  has_reactivity & reactivity_chr %in% c("Yes", "No", "Auto-reactive", "EBV", "CMV"),
  reactivity_chr,
  ifelse(
    !has_reactivity & has_match,
    "TCR library tested",
    "NA"
  )
)
legend_order <- c("Yes", "No", "Auto-reactive", "EBV", "CMV", "TCR library tested", "NA")
draw_order <- c("NA", "TCR library tested", "No", "Auto-reactive", "EBV", "CMV", "Yes")
obj$reactivity_plot <- factor(obj$reactivity_plot, levels = legend_order)
emb <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(obj, reduction = "umap"))
umap_cols <- colnames(emb)[1:2]
plot_df <- cbind(
  emb[Cells(obj), umap_cols, drop = FALSE],
  obj@meta.data[Cells(obj), c("time", "reactivity_plot"), drop = FALSE]
)
plot_df$reactivity_plot <- factor(plot_df$reactivity_plot, levels = legend_order)
plot_df$time <- factor(as.character(plot_df$time), levels = c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6"))
plot_df$point_size <- ifelse(
  plot_df$reactivity_plot == "Yes", 1,
  ifelse(plot_df$reactivity_plot %in% c("No", "Auto-reactive", "EBV", "CMV"), 0.5, 0.25)
)
plot_df$point_alpha <- ifelse(
  plot_df$reactivity_plot == "Yes", 1,
  ifelse(plot_df$reactivity_plot %in% c("No", "Auto-reactive", "EBV", "CMV"), 0.75, 0.75)
)
plot_df$draw_priority <- match(as.character(plot_df$reactivity_plot), draw_order)
plot_df <- plot_df[order(plot_df$draw_priority), , drop = FALSE]
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  plot_df,
  ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[umap_cols[1]]], y = .data[[umap_cols[2]]])
) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(color = reactivity_plot, size = point_size, alpha = point_alpha)
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~time, nrow = 1) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    values = reactivity_colors[legend_order],
    breaks = legend_order,
    drop = FALSE,
    name = "Reactivity"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_size_identity() +
  ggplot2::scale_alpha_identity() +
  ggplot2::guides(
    color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = c(3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1.5, 1.5), alpha = 1)
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle("Tested reactive and non-reactive T cells") +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() +
  ggplot2::theme_classic() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "plain")
  )
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("FigureS8d_", compartment, "_umap_reactivity_time.pdf")), width = 12.5, height = 7.5, plot = p)
print(p)
```

### Fig. S9a

General overview of PBL-TIL distribution.

```{r}
time_levels <- c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
alluvial_col <- "manual.annotation"
alluvial_palette <- manual_colors
alluvial_na_label <- "NA"
alluvial_na_col <- "gray85"
if (!alluvial_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) {
  stop("Column not found in obj@meta.data: ", alluvial_col)
}
state_global <- as.character(obj@meta.data[[alluvial_col]])
state_global <- ifelse(is.na(state_global) | state_global %in% c("", "NA", "<NA>"), alluvial_na_label, state_global)
state_levels <- sort(unique(state_global))
state_levels <- state_levels[!is.na(state_levels)]
if (is.null(names(alluvial_palette))) {
  state_cols <- setNames(alluvial_palette[seq_along(state_levels)], state_levels)
} else {
  state_cols <- alluvial_palette[state_levels]
}
if (alluvial_na_label %in% state_levels && alluvial_na_label %in% names(state_cols) && is.na(state_cols[alluvial_na_label])) {
  state_cols[alluvial_na_label] <- alluvial_na_col
}
if (alluvial_na_label %in% state_levels && !alluvial_na_label %in% names(state_cols)) {
  state_cols <- c(state_cols, setNames(alluvial_na_col, alluvial_na_label))
}
if (any(is.na(state_cols))) {
  stop("Some levels are missing in alluvial_palette: ", paste(state_levels[is.na(state_cols)], collapse = ", "))
}
df <- obj@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(tumor == "yes") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    time = factor(as.character(time), levels = time_levels),
    state = as.character(.data[[alluvial_col]]),
    state = ifelse(is.na(state) | state %in% c("", "NA", "<NA>"), alluvial_na_label, state),
    state = factor(state, levels = state_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(time, state, name = "n") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    time = factor(time_levels, levels = time_levels),
    state = factor(state_levels, levels = state_levels),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(time) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = ifelse(sum(n) > 0, 100 * n / sum(n), 0)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 0)
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  df,
  ggplot2::aes(x = time, stratum = state, alluvium = state, y = n, fill = state)
) +
  ggalluvial::geom_flow(stat = "alluvium", lode.guidance = "forward", alpha = 0.75) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = state_cols,
    limits = names(state_cols),
    breaks = names(state_cols),
    drop = FALSE,
    name = alluvial_col
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = time_levels) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Temporal Dynamics of Tumor PBL-TIL",
    x = "Time",
    y = "Number of cells"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    aspect.ratio = 0.5,
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.4, "cm"),
    axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "plain")
  )
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("FigureS9a_", compartment, "_alluvial_TIL_manual.annotation.pdf")), width = 7.5, height = 5, plot = p)
print(p)
```

### Fig. S9b

Location in the UMAP of the TCR library-tested PBL-TILs and their reactivity.

```{r}
# --- Parameters ---
highlight_color_col <- "manual.annotation"
highlight_palette <- manual_colors
reactivity_sets <- list(
  Reactive = "Yes",
  Auto_reactive = "Auto-reactive",
  CMV_EBV = c("CMV", "EBV")
)
plot_titles <- c(
  Reactive = "Tumor-reactive PBL-TIL",
  Auto_reactive = "Auto-reactive PBL-TIL",
  CMV_EBV = "Viral-reactive PBL-TIL"
)
time_levels <- c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
context_cols <- c(
  "Tumor+tested" = "gray20",
  "Tumor" = "#3c4b99",
  "PBL" = "gray90"
)
shape_pool <- c(
  0, 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 3, 4, 8, 9,
  10, 11, 12, 13, 14,
  21, 22, 23, 24, 25,
  35, 38, 16, 17, 18
)
reserve_shapes <- c(35, 38, 16, 17, 18)
reserve_alpha <- 1
reserve_size <- 3.0
default_alpha <- 1
default_size <- 4.0
# --- Setup ---
id_col <- if ("id" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) "id" else "matched_ID"
match_col <- if ("matched_ID" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) "matched_ID" else id_col
bad_values <- c("", "NA", "<NA>")
if (!highlight_color_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) {
  stop("Column not found in obj@meta.data: ", highlight_color_col)
}
if (!exists("true_hits") || !all(c("TCR.ID", "TCR.shape") %in% colnames(true_hits))) {
  stop("true_hits must exist and contain columns: TCR.ID and TCR.shape")
}
highlight_levels <- unique(as.character(obj@meta.data[[highlight_color_col]]))
highlight_levels <- highlight_levels[!is.na(highlight_levels) & !highlight_levels %in% bad_values]
missing_cols <- setdiff(highlight_levels, names(highlight_palette))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Some levels in ", highlight_color_col, " are missing in highlight_palette: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}
highlight_cols <- highlight_palette[intersect(names(highlight_palette), highlight_levels)]
color_mapping <- c(highlight_cols, context_cols)
all_reactivity_values <- unique(unlist(reactivity_sets))
highlighted_ids <- as.character(obj@meta.data[[id_col]])[
  obj$tumor %in% "yes" &
    obj$reactivity %in% all_reactivity_values
]
highlighted_ids <- highlighted_ids[!is.na(highlighted_ids) & !highlighted_ids %in% bad_values]
clone_counts <- sort(table(highlighted_ids), decreasing = TRUE)
shape_mapping <- true_hits %>%
  dplyr::distinct(TCR.ID, TCR.shape) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TCR.ID = as.character(TCR.ID),
    TCR.shape = as.integer(TCR.shape)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TCR.ID), !is.na(TCR.shape)) %>%
  tibble::deframe()
missing_shape_ids <- setdiff(names(clone_counts), names(shape_mapping))
if (length(missing_shape_ids) > 0) {
  free_shapes <- setdiff(shape_pool, unname(shape_mapping))
  if (length(missing_shape_ids) > length(free_shapes)) {
    stop("Not enough shapes for missing highlighted IDs.")
  }
  shape_mapping <- c(shape_mapping, setNames(free_shapes[seq_along(missing_shape_ids)], missing_shape_ids))
}
shape_alpha_mapping <- setNames(ifelse(shape_mapping %in% reserve_shapes, reserve_alpha, default_alpha), names(shape_mapping))
shape_size_mapping <- setNames(ifelse(shape_mapping %in% reserve_shapes, reserve_size, default_size), names(shape_mapping))
# --- Plot data ---
emb <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(obj, reduction = "umap"))
umap_cols <- colnames(emb)[1:2]
meta_cols <- unique(c("time", "tumor", "reactivity", id_col, match_col, highlight_color_col))
plot_base <- cbind(
  emb[Seurat::Cells(obj), umap_cols, drop = FALSE],
  obj@meta.data[Seurat::Cells(obj), meta_cols, drop = FALSE]
)
plot_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(reactivity_sets), function(x) {
  tmp <- plot_base
  tested <- !is.na(tmp[[match_col]]) & !as.character(tmp[[match_col]]) %in% bad_values
  tmp$panel_title <- plot_titles[[x]]
  tmp$category <- dplyr::case_when(
    tmp$tumor %in% "yes" & tmp$reactivity %in% reactivity_sets[[x]] ~ "Reactive",
    tmp$tumor %in% "yes" & tested ~ "Tumor+tested",
    tmp$tumor %in% "yes" ~ "Tumor",
    TRUE ~ "PBL"
  )
  tmp$plot_color_group <- ifelse(
    tmp$category == "Reactive",
    as.character(tmp[[highlight_color_col]]),
    tmp$category
  )
  tmp$shape_clone <- ifelse(
    tmp$category == "Reactive" & as.character(tmp[[id_col]]) %in% names(shape_mapping),
    as.character(tmp[[id_col]]),
    NA_character_
  )
  tmp
}))
plot_df$time <- factor(plot_df$time, levels = time_levels)
plot_df$panel_title <- factor(plot_df$panel_title, levels = plot_titles)
plot_df$category <- factor(plot_df$category, levels = c("PBL", "Tumor", "Tumor+tested", "Reactive"))
shape_breaks <- intersect(names(clone_counts), unique(stats::na.omit(as.character(plot_df$shape_clone))))
plot_df$shape_clone <- factor(plot_df$shape_clone, levels = shape_breaks)
plot_df$point_alpha <- ifelse(shape_mapping[as.character(plot_df$shape_clone)] %in% reserve_shapes, reserve_alpha, default_alpha)
plot_df$point_size <- ifelse(shape_mapping[as.character(plot_df$shape_clone)] %in% reserve_shapes, reserve_size, default_size)
color_breaks <- unique(as.character(plot_df$plot_color_group))
color_breaks <- color_breaks[!is.na(color_breaks) & color_breaks %in% names(color_mapping)]
color_breaks <- c(
  intersect(names(highlight_cols), color_breaks),
  intersect(names(context_cols), color_breaks)
)
df_context <- plot_df[plot_df$category != "Reactive", , drop = FALSE]
df_reactive <- plot_df[plot_df$category == "Reactive", , drop = FALSE]
# --- Plot ---
p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = df_context,
    ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[umap_cols[1]]], y = .data[[umap_cols[2]]], color = plot_color_group),
    size = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.85,
    shape = 16
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = df_reactive,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data[[umap_cols[1]]],
      y = .data[[umap_cols[2]]],
      color = plot_color_group,
      shape = shape_clone,
      alpha = point_alpha,
      size = point_size
    ),
    stroke = 0.75,
    fill = NA
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(panel_title ~ time) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    name = "Group",
    values = color_mapping,
    breaks = color_breaks,
    drop = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(
    name = "TCR.ID",
    values = shape_mapping[shape_breaks],
    breaks = shape_breaks,
    drop = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_alpha_identity() +
  ggplot2::scale_size_identity() +
  ggplot2::guides(
    color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      title = "Group",
      override.aes = list(size = 2.8, alpha = 1, shape = 16),
      order = 1
    ),
    shape = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      title = "TCR.ID",
      override.aes = list(
        size = shape_size_mapping[shape_breaks],
        stroke = 0.45,
        alpha = shape_alpha_mapping[shape_breaks],
        fill = NA
      ),
      order = 2
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() +
  ggplot2::theme_classic() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "plain"),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25)
  )
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("FigureS9b_", compartment, "_umap_PBL_TIL_reactive_ID.pdf")), width = 10, height = 10, plot = p)
print(p)
```

### Fig. S9c

Alluvial plots of reactive PBL-TILs.

```{r}
highlighted_clones <- c("ID.024", "ID.640", "ID.746")
time_levels <- c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
alluvial_col <- "manual.annotation"
alluvial_palette <- manual_colors
alluvial_na_label <- "NA"
alluvial_na_col <- "gray85"
id_col <- if ("id" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) "id" else "matched_ID"
if (!alluvial_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) {
  stop("Column not found in obj@meta.data: ", alluvial_col)
}
df <- obj@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% highlighted_clones) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    id = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = highlighted_clones),
    time = factor(as.character(time), levels = time_levels),
    state = as.character(.data[[alluvial_col]]),
    state = ifelse(is.na(state) | state %in% c("", "NA", "<NA>"), alluvial_na_label, state)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, time, state)
state_levels <- sort(unique(as.character(df$state)))
state_levels <- state_levels[!is.na(state_levels)]
if (is.null(names(alluvial_palette))) {
  state_cols <- setNames(alluvial_palette[seq_along(state_levels)], state_levels)
} else {
  state_cols <- alluvial_palette[state_levels]
}
if (alluvial_na_label %in% state_levels && alluvial_na_label %in% names(state_cols) && is.na(state_cols[alluvial_na_label])) {
  state_cols[alluvial_na_label] <- alluvial_na_col
}
if (alluvial_na_label %in% state_levels && !alluvial_na_label %in% names(state_cols)) {
  state_cols <- c(state_cols, setNames(alluvial_na_col, alluvial_na_label))
}
if (any(is.na(state_cols))) {
  stop("Some levels are missing in alluvial_palette: ", paste(state_levels[is.na(state_cols)], collapse = ", "))
}
df_summary <- df %>%
  dplyr::count(id, time, state, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    time = factor(time_levels, levels = time_levels),
    state = factor(state_levels, levels = state_levels),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    id = factor(id, levels = highlighted_clones),
    time = factor(as.character(time), levels = time_levels),
    state = factor(as.character(state), levels = state_levels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 0)
if (nrow(df_summary) == 0) {
  stop("No cells found for highlighted_clones.")
}
max_y <- df_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id, time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::pull(total) %>%
  max(na.rm = TRUE)

# --- Plot ---
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  df_summary,
  ggplot2::aes(x = time, stratum = state, alluvium = state, y = n, fill = state)
) +
  ggalluvial::geom_flow(stat = "alluvium", lode.guidance = "frontback", alpha = 0.75) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    ggplot2::aes(label = ggplot2::after_stat(count)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~id, ncol = 1) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max_y),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = state_cols,
    limits = names(state_cols),
    breaks = names(state_cols),
    drop = FALSE,
    name = alluvial_col
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = time_levels) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Time", y = "Cell count") +
  ggplot2::guides(
    fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      title = alluvial_col,
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    aspect.ratio = 0.5,
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.4, "cm"),
    axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "plain")
  )
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("FigureS9c_", compartment, "_alluvial_PBL_TIL_reactive_ID.pdf")), width = 7.5, height = 7.5, plot = p)
print(p)
```

# CD8T

## Load data.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
sample <- "vhio136"
compartment <- "cd8_int"
obj <- readRDS(file.path(int_dir, "seurat", paste0(compartment, ".rds")))
obj@meta.data$time <- factor(obj@meta.data$time, levels = c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6"))
plots_list <- list()

# Keep the latest STACAS reduction
stacas_cols <- grep("^STACAS_snn_res\\.", colnames(obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
if (!length(stacas_cols)) stop("No STACAS_snn_res.* columns found.")
stacas_col <- tail(stacas_cols, 1)
obj@meta.data[head(stacas_cols, -1)] <- NULL
stacas_col

# Save plots
if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
  dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

cd8_int: 539 unique TCRs (535 library + 4 reconstructed)

```{r}
message("Number of TCRs tested in ", compartment, ": ", length(unique(unlist(strsplit(as.character(na.omit(obj$matched_ID)), ";")))))
table(obj$reactivity)
```

## Adjust

Merge the reactivity annotation with viral-recognition information. First, assess whether there is any overlap between epitope_species and reactive IDs. No overlap is detected, except for ID.198, which is annotated as non-reactive and matches EBV. Therefore, I annotate these cells as EBV.

```{r}
table(
  reactivity = !is.na(obj$reactivity),
  viral_epitope = !is.na(obj$epitope_species)
)
overlap_idx <- which(!is.na(obj$reactivity) & !is.na(obj$epitope_species))
overlap_cells <- rownames(obj@meta.data)[overlap_idx]
obj@meta.data[overlap_cells, c("reactivity", "epitope_species", "matched_ID", "tumor", "time", "sample", "clonotype_id", "cdr3", "v_gene", "j_gene"), drop = FALSE]

```

Number of cells with annotated specificity.

```{r}
idx <- !is.na(obj$epitope_species)
obj$reactivity[idx] <- as.character(obj$epitope_species[idx])
table(obj$reactivity, useNA = "ifany")
```

### Fig. S7c

Tested TCR library

```{r}
criteria_simplified_chr <- as.character(obj$criteria_simplified)
criteria_simplified_chr[is.na(criteria_simplified_chr) | criteria_simplified_chr %in% c("", "NA", "<NA>")] <- "Non tested"
missing_levels <- setdiff(unique(criteria_simplified_chr), names(criteria_colors))
if (length(missing_levels) > 0) {
  stop("Levels missing in criteria_colors: ", paste(missing_levels, collapse = ", "))
}
criteria_levels <- c(setdiff(names(criteria_colors), "Non tested"), "Non tested")
criteria_levels <- criteria_levels[criteria_levels %in% unique(criteria_simplified_chr)]
criteria_levels <- c(setdiff(criteria_levels, "Non tested"), "Non tested")
obj$criteria_simplified <- factor(criteria_simplified_chr, levels = criteria_levels)
p <- DimPlot(obj,
             reduction = "umap",
             group.by = "criteria_simplified",
             pt.size = 0.15,
             order = setdiff(criteria_levels, "Non tested"),
             cols = criteria_colors[criteria_levels],
             label = FALSE) + 
  ggtitle(paste0("Tested_",
                 length(unique(unlist(strsplit(as.character(na.omit(obj$matched_ID)), ";")))),
                 "_TCRs")) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("FigureS7c_", compartment, "_umap_tested_TCRs.pdf")), width = 7.5, height = 7.5, plot = p)
print(p)
```
